evidence.title: Synthetic Memory Retrieval Study
evidence.heading: Methods and results
evidence.text: We studied memory retrieval using a synthetic key-value task on a CPU. The baseline returned the most recent matching entry. Evaluation measured exact-match retrieval on 40 original toy records. These observations are invented test data, not published research. Long-context robustness beyond this toy setting was not evaluated.

evidence.title: Synthetic Context Ordering Note
evidence.heading: Conditions and limitations
evidence.text: This original synthetic fixture considers passage ordering with distractor entries. A fixed retrieval order was used in all toy conditions. The ordering comparison was left untested. Dataset size, statistical power, and generalization are unknown. This document is for software tests and is not evidence of a scientific discovery.
